jobs.title: Senior Director, Contact Centre Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
Our Story & Purpose:

We’re Vancity, a member-owned credit union built on the principles of inclusion and social justice. Since 1946, our relentless commitment to these values has helped us challenge the status quo and break down barriers. We’ve made bold commitments to become net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans, and we’re actively pursuing strategies in Indigenous banking and financial resilience for our members.  
As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada, we’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the country’s Top Employers. If you’re ready to join our team of 2,300 diverse individuals, access competitive rewards and benefits, and be part of a greater movement - apply today!   
Your Role in Supporting Our Members:

As a Senior Director, Contact Centre Operations & Transformation
, you will provide enterprise-level leadership for the modernization of Vancity’s contact centre into a scalable, resilient, and advice-led channel. You will own the multi-year transformation agenda, shaping the future-state operating model, workforce strategy, quality framework, service model, governance routines, and technology-enabled capabilities.   
We’re looking for an accomplished strategic and operational leader who can navigate complex transformation and turn enterprise priorities into measurable results.   
This is a Full-time, Permanent
role based at our Surrey Central City Office
and will report directly to the VP, Inclusive Banking, Alternate Channels
. While this position provides a hybrid work arrangement, you will be expected to be on-site for events and business demands.  
How You'll Make an Impact:

Set the multi-year contact centre strategy, transformation roadmap, future-state operating model, and measures of success.  
Lead through leaders to build an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing culture.  
Modernize workforce management, quality, reporting, IVR, routing, automation, and enabling technology.  
Use operational, financial, risk and member insights to guide investment, capacity, and continuous improvement.  
Ensure strong oversight of risk, compliance, privacy, fraud, business continuity, and service quality.  
Partner across technology, digital, product, operations, and member-facing teams to deliver measurable transformation outcomes.  

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

Post-secondary education in business, technology, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.  
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in contact centre operations, financial services, or large-scale transformation.  
Experience leading leaders and complex operational portfolios across people, financial, risk and member outcomes.  
A strong record of delivering transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating models, and service-model change.  
Experience modernizing contact centre capabilities, including workforce planning, quality, reporting, routing, automation, or digital platforms.  
Sound knowledge of risk, compliance, privacy, fraud, business continuity, and operational controls in a regulated environment.  
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to influence executives, partners, vendors, and frontline teams.  

Extra Skills That Set You Apart: 

A recognized change management, continuous improvement, or contact centre designation, such as Prosci, Lean Six Sigma or CCXP.  
Experience with Genesys or comparable enterprise contact centre technology.  
Success shifting a large contact centre from transactional service to advice-led member engagement.  

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are: 

Strategic and future-focused
- You turn enterprise priorities into practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.  
Member-centred
- You put member relationships, financial well-being, and service quality first.  
Collaborative and influential
- You build alignment across leaders, partners, vendors, and frontline teams.  
Decisive and people-focused
- You create clarity, accountability, and inclusion through complex change.  

We value lived experience, so if you are interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if you feel your skills don't perfectly align with those listed.  

What You’ll Earn:

This role offers a salary range of  $165,500 to $204,435 per annum
. The base pay offered may vary depending on factors such as relevant qualifications, skills, previous experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards package, employees may also be eligible for our annual incentive program, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

**Posting Deadline: Please apply by Wednesday, November 4th, at 3:00pm. **

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

A career at Vancity is more than just a job, you’re joining a tradition of change-makers who are creating lasting change for our communities. Beyond base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package to ensure our employees are empowered to thrive:  
Purpose-driven workplace
: Join Canada’s largest private-sector Living Wage Employer and one of the country’s Top Employers.  
Flexible benefits
: Customize your health and dental coverage from your first day.  
Time to recharge
: Start with 3-4 weeks of vacation, plus additional holidays, and care days.  
Defined benefit pension
: Build toward a reliable, guaranteed retirement income.  

Vancity Talent Programs:

Vancity supports an inclusive hiring process for candidates who self-identify as Indigenous, Black, or Trans. With special permission from the BC Human Rights Commissioner, this initiative provides access to career development opportunities, prioritized job screening, and feedback. Any information you choose to share will be stored securely and used only for recruitment and career development connected to this initiative, in line with the BC Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA). For details, please see our dedicated Talent Programs job posting.  
At Vancity we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace to help our people and communities thrive and prosper. Diversity in our workforce is integral so that we can truly represent, understand and respond to our community needs and deliver on our member experience.  
We are also committed to an inclusive, barrier-free, and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require any accommodations or support at any stage of the recruitment process (including the application stage), we encourage you to let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@vancity.com. We’re here to work with you to ensure your needs are met promptly and effectively. All requests will be handled with the utmost respect and confidentiality, so you can participate fully in the process.

jobs.title: Director, Information Systems
jobs.description:
The Director/Senior Director Technology Audit and Advisory Services is accountable for the delivery of high quality, professional, cost-effective, value-added, and risk-based internal audit services over Technology functions, across North America (Canada and US Segment), Global Wealth & Asset Management, Group Functions, and the Global Data Technology Office. The role reports to the AVP of North America Segment Technology, Audit Services.

Position Responsibilities

Audit Delivery – Delivery of North America Segment Technology, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity (steady state/key risk, program and project, business integrated, issue assessments).
Technology SOX – Delivery of application and infrastructure technology SOX audit work and to drive our approach and processes for this work forward through use of automation, data analytics, and shared services.
Reporting and Planning – Execution and continuous improvement of reporting processes in support of the larger technology audit organization, as well as annual audit planning, resource management, and other process improvements for the immediate North America segment technology audit team.
Other – Audit initiatives, engagements, and process improvements as assigned.

Strategic Leadership

Understand the company’s strategy, operations, and regulatory environment to proactively identify areas of emerging and heightened risk related to technology that affects the company
Support the development of an audit strategy that aligns to business, technology, and Audit Services strategies, provides sufficient coverage for key risks while meeting regulatory expectations
Develop internal procedures and tools to drive consistency across all engagements and drive audit planning
Help improve Technology SOX delivery and quality to improve efficiencies through increased use of data analytics, automation and shared services and other innovations
Develop and produce meaningful reports for Senior Technology Management that identify trends and enable continuous improvement of risks and controls
Contribute to the development of Audit Services procedures, strategy, and direction; continually improve audit and supporting processes leveraging technology to the fullest

Audit Delivery and Oversight

Plan and direct audits and special audit projects to objectively evaluate the effectiveness of key controls and adequacy of risk management practices; collaborating with management to obtain a consensus on establishing the problem, risks exposure; produce meaningful audit reports that clearly articulate the position on risks and related issues, while meeting Audit Services operational targets related to budget, timeline and quality of execution
Delivery of annual Technology Application and Infrastructure ITGC SOX work, in collaboration with Technology Management, SOX PMO, and external audit
Perform integrated/cross-functional audits in partnership with groups across Audit Services to provide comprehensive reporting on risks that could prevent the achievement of Management’s objectives
Support the development of an annual audit plan using risk management processes, in collaboration with Management and Audit Services leadership
Drive innovation and incorporate and develop industry best practices into forward thinking audit approach; manage Audit Services’ resources efficiently, economically, and effectively
Provide management with timely recommendations that reduce risk, help them run their business better, make strategic and operational decisions, and oversee management of risks and controls
Monitoring progress in implementing control recommendations and reporting thereon; assist with preparation of Audit Committee and senior leadership reports

Leadership & People Development

Lead and develop a high-caliber audit team, attract, and retain top talent and provide appropriate development, coaching and training
Foster creative culture that strives for continuous improvement and welcomes and offers feedback—enabling best-in-class audit practices
Challenge, coach and enable the team members to develop to their fullest and maximize their contribution to the team
Drive team skills development and engagement; manage talent across the team for development and succession and rotate change expertise

Stakeholder Management

Managing Management’s expectations regarding assurance and advisory work deadlines and deliverables
Providing relevant stakeholders with an overview of audit work and commentary on the control environment, including trends and emerging issues that could impact the Company
Collaborate effectively with divisional and global stakeholders in Technology and Information Risk Management
Establishing a high level of credibility and building professional relationships with key stakeholders responsible for technology and information risk across the Company

Required Qualifications

Exceptional communications judgement and the ability to communicate clearly and succinctly to effectively deliver key messages verbally and in writing and to listen and consider various perspectives; confident presentation and facilitation skills and strong interpersonal and leadership skills to facilitate working with senior management at all levels
Ability to quickly understand business processes and risks, identify key controls, analyze complex situations, reach appropriate conclusions, make value-added and practical recommendations and influence management to take appropriate actions on recommendations
In-depth knowledge of audit methodologies, project management and system development methodologies (including Agile), control frameworks and risk management practices, and regulatory requirements; Exceptional understanding of how technology supports business strategies, the latest technology and cyber security trends, best practices, and industry standards; excellent working knowledge of risks affecting financial institutions and insurance industry
Experience working with external auditors (Statutory Audit, SOX, SOC 1 and 2 engagements) effectively and helping technology management understand the impacts
Previous people management experience preferred, with the ability to lead and motivate a team of professionals in a new and rapidly changing environment to deliver with timeliness and quality
Results oriented with a keen focus on quality and delivering value; ability to balance multiple priorities and projects; strong attention to detail while retaining focus on the “big picture” and top risks; flexible and organized with the ability to oversee multiple projects concurrently
Excellent influencing, relationship building and negotiation skills; professional presence, ability to navigate a matrix environment and influence across different areas and levels of management both in Audit Services and Technology
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in diverse environments and cultures, over multiple office locations
Ability to identify opportunities to utilize data analytics for enhanced depth and breadth of audit coverage
Relevant post-secondary education or equivalent experience, plus a recognized auditing (e.g., CA, CPA, CISA) or security (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH) designation/certification or equivalent experience, with experience typically gained from 6-8+ years in relevant roles
Highest level of integrity, accompanied by strong ethical principles

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

jobs.title: Deals Value Creation Analytics Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in deals focus on providing strategic advice and support to clients in areas such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring. They help clients navigate complex transactions and maximise value in their business deals. Those in deal integration and valuation realisation at PwC will focus on assisting clients in successfully integrating acquisitions and maximising the value of their investments. You will be responsible for conducting valuations, financial analysis, and developing strategies for post-merger integration.

The Opportunity

As a Director in Deals Value Creation Analytics, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping clients use data, analytics, and AI to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading high-profile analytics engagements across sell-side, buy-side, value creation, and performance improvement contexts, translating complex data into clear commercial insights
Helping management teams and investors understand business performance, growth drivers, customer behaviour, pricing, revenue quality, margins, operational efficiency, and value creation opportunities
Bringing together financial, commercial, operational, and technical perspectives to support fact-based decision making
Structuring ambiguous problems, defining analytical workplans, and guiding teams from data discovery through to executive-ready insights and deliverables
Leading business development activities, including opportunity identification, relationship building, proposal development, client pitches, and broader practice growth
Building relationships across PwC to support integrated client solutions, including across Deals, Consulting, Tax, Assurance, and data and AI teams
Supporting the development of the Value Creation Analytics practice, including methodologies, tools, reusable assets, delivery standards, and market-facing propositions
Coaching and developing team members across technical, commercial, financial, and client-facing skills
Most importantly, we need you to become a business partner and strategic advisor to our clients, translating and communicating your analysis to help answer critical commercial questions.

What You’ll Bring

Significant experience in analytics, corporate finance, value creation, management consulting, corporate development, private equity, M&A, or a related field
Experience leading client engagements, managing teams, and delivering high-quality work under tight timelines
Experience supporting transactions, performance improvement, value creation, corporate strategy, finance transformation, or related advisory work
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to understand business drivers and translate data into practical insights for executives, investors, and management teams
Strong understanding of financial analysis and business case development, including forecasting, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, KPI driver trees, and investment case support
Experience contributing to business development, including opportunity identification, proposal development, client pitches, and relationship building
Proven ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders at multiple levels
Experience working with complex data environments and guiding teams through data structuring, transformation, analysis, visualization, and insight development
Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, and AI-enabled delivery tools, with the ability to identify practical use cases for AI, automation, and analytics in client delivery and business operations
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex financial, operational, technical, or analytical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong people leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop high-performing teams
A collaborative working style and a demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard
Ability and willingness to travel up to approximately 20% within Canada and internationally

This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.

The salary range for this position is $175,000 - $225,000. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

jobs.title: Cloud Architecture & Engineering, Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations. They enable the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centres to optimise performance and minimise downtime. Those in site reliability engineering at PwC will focus on enabling the reliability, scalability, and performance of organisational technology infrastructure. This will include working to automate processes, monitor systems, and resolve incidents to maintain a seamless user experience.

Meaningful work you’ll be part of

As a Director, Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve business issues, deliver high-quality client service and operational efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

You will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of cloud strategy, architecture, engineering, and client engagement.  
This role combines deep technical cloud expertise with strategic leadership, practice development, and team coaching.  
You will shape and scale cloud capabilities, guide clients through complex transformation journeys, and help drive PwC’s cloud first vision. 
You will be responsible for designing and governing enterprise grade cloud architectures while also driving advisory engagements, leading teams, strengthening client relationships, and contributing to the innovation pipeline for cloud-based solutions and assets. 
This role requires a seasoned cloud leader who can operate fluently across business strategy, modern cloud architectures, and hands-on technical depth—while mentoring teams and influencing both internal and client executives.

Cloud Architecture & Engineering Leadership

Lead the design, governance, and implementation of end-to-end cloud architectures aligned to business goals and industry best practices. 
Architect scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
Develop cloud foundation blueprints, reference architectures, and reusable patterns. 
Oversee the design and optimization of Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE) and containerized environments. 
Guide the development and automation of cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, ARM, etc.). 
Provide technical guidance on compute, storage, networking, security, identity, data services, and DevOps tooling. 

Cloud Advisory & Client Engagement

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive-level stakeholders, helping them define and execute cloud strategies and operating models. 
Assess existing environments, develop modernization roadmaps, and oversee cloud migration programs. 
Lead proposal creation, solutioning activities, statements of work, and client presentations. 
Communicate complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences clearly and effectively. 
Identify and prioritize client use cases and translate business requirements into architectural approaches and execution plans. 

Practice & Team Leadership

Build, lead, and mentor teams of cloud architects, engineers, and technical specialists. 
Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and cloud innovation. 
Recruit and grow diverse technical talent, ensuring strong career development and retention. 
Collaborate with practice leadership to define strategic direction, emerging offerings, and go-to-market assets. 
Lead initiatives that strengthen practice foundations: capability models, delivery frameworks, accelerators, patterns, and reusable assets. 

Innovation, Delivery & Thought Leadership

Lead technical innovation cycles to evaluate, test, and showcase new cloud technologies, tools, and architectures. 
Drive and participate in hands-on cloud prototyping, labbing, and solution validation. 
Develop technical demos, asset-driven solutions, and market-aligned accelerators. 
Present at internal and external events, contributing to PwC’s thought leadership presence. 
Maintain active engagement with cloud provider alliances and product engineering teams to share early insights and influence product evolution. 

Experiences And Skills you’ll use To Solve 

Technical Expertise

Extensive experience in cloud architecture and engineering across AWS (primary), Azure, and/or GCP. 
Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, microservices, serverless architectures, and modern DevOps practices. 
Hands-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform strongly preferred), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Argo, etc.), and automated deployment patterns. 
Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, network segmentation, encryption, monitoring, cost optimization, and governance frameworks. 
Experience supporting modernization programs such as application migration, refactoring, API strategies, and technical debt remediation. 
AI-assisted development and prior experience deploying agentic workloads and MLOps pipelines is an asset.

Leadership & Consulting Skills

Demonstrated experience leading cloud-focused teams and initiatives in a complex, multistakeholder environment. 
Strong executive communication skills suitable for client-facing consulting environments. 
Ability to bridge business and technical perspectives and articulate value propositions, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs. 
Strategic mindset with a bias toward execution, innovation, and measurable impact. 

Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
Significant cloud architecture and engineering leadership experience. 
Preferred:  AWS Solutions Architect (Professional); Azure or GCP Architect certifications; Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or CKAD; Terraform Associate Certification.
Ability to obtain Government of Canada Security Clearance; Level 2 security clearance is an asset.
This role does not require professional engineering licensure and is not classified as a formal engineering position under provincial regulatory definitions. While individuals with a P.Eng designation are welcome to apply, the responsibilities of this role do not involve the practice of professional engineering as defined by applicable legislation.
PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer. 

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Le/la chef(fe) de projet, déploiement de l'automatisation, est un(e) expert(e) reconnu(e) en robotique et en automatisation, responsable de la coordination de la construction, de l'intégration et de la mise en service de bout en bout des solutions d'automatisation à l'échelle de l'entreprise GE Vernova. Ce(tte) professionnel(le) de haut niveau travaille de façon transversale avec des intégrateurs de systèmes, des équipes de préparation de site et des architectes technologiques pour assurer une exécution de projet et une transition opérationnelle harmonieuses. Le/la responsable du déploiement de l'automatisation gère les échéanciers, les budgets et l'alignement des intervenants afin de livrer des projets d'automatisation conformes aux exigences rigoureuses en matière de performance, de sécurité et de cybersécurité. Fort(e) d'une expertise approfondie en automatisation industrielle et en gestion de programmes/projets, ce rôle favorise des déploiements réussis dans des environnements complexes et à grande échelle. Le/la responsable du déploiement de l'automatisation joue un rôle crucial dans l'orientation de la stratégie mondiale d'automatisation de GE Vernova grâce à une implication soutenue sur le terrain et au sein de l'écosystème de l'automatisation.

The Automation Deployment Lead is a recognized expert in robotics and automation responsible for coordinating the end-to-end build, integration, and commissioning of automation solutions across GE Vernova’s enterprise. This senior professional works cross-functionally with system integrators, site readiness teams, and technology architects to ensure seamless project execution and handover into operations. The Automation Deployment Leader manages timelines, budgets, and stakeholder alignment to deliver automation projects that meet rigorous performance, safety, and cybersecurity requirements. With deep expertise in industrial automation and formal program/project management, this role drives successful deployments in complex, large-scale environments. The Automation and Deployment leader is critical in shaping and directing GE Vernova’s global automation strategy through deep engagement in the shops and throughout the automation ecosystem.

Job Description

Responsabilités essentielles :

Coordonner les activités de construction, d'intégration et de mise en service des projets d'automatisation, en assurant le respect des échéanciers et des budgets.
Diriger et exécuter le développement de la portée, des échéanciers, des livrables et des exigences d'intégration du projet, en partenariat avec les intégrateurs de systèmes, les équipes techniques internes et les responsables de la préparation des sites.
Piloter tous les aspects du déploiement de l'automatisation, incluant l'installation, les tests, la validation et la transition vers la production, en assurant la conformité aux normes de sécurité et de cybersécurité.
Gérer les risques, les problèmes et les changements tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, en assurant une communication proactive et une résolution rapide.
Suivre la performance du projet par rapport aux indicateurs clés de performance (ICP), aux jalons et au budget établis, en faisant rapport régulièrement au directeur, Intégration et Mise en service.
Établir et tenir à jour la documentation relative aux plans de projet, aux spécifications techniques, aux listes de contrôle de mise en service et aux leçons apprises.
Collaborer avec les architectes technologiques pour garantir des solutions robustes, évolutives et adaptées aux besoins.
Soutenir la gestion des fournisseurs et la supervision de la performance durant les phases de construction et de mise en service.
Favoriser l'amélioration continue en assurant des revues après-projet et en partageant les meilleures pratiques de déploiement de l'automatisation.
Favoriser l'établissement de solides relations de travail avec les intervenants de l'ingénierie, des opérations, de la sécurité, de la cybersécurité et des fonctions TI/OT.

Qualifications/Exigences

Baccalauréat en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, assorti de plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'automatisation industrielle au sein de grandes organisations OU Diplôme d'études collégiales (ou équivalent) en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, assorti de plus de 10 ans d'expérience pertinente.
Bilingue français/anglais fluide requis. L'employé(e) sera amené(e) à interagir de manière fluide avec des collègues de nos autres installations à travers et/ou à l'extérieur du Canada, et qui sont généralement incapables de communiquer en français et dont la langue de travail est principalement l'anglais.
Expertise dans la gestion réussie de projets d'automatisation vastes et complexes, de la conception jusqu'à la mise en service.
Connaissance experte des architectures d'automatisation, des normes de sécurité et des exigences de cybersécurité en milieu industriel.
Solides compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et de résolution de problèmes.
Excellentes capacités de collaboration, de gestion des fournisseurs et de mobilisation des intervenants.
Compétences supérieures en communication, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral.
Autorisation légale de travailler au Canada requise. Nous ne parrainerons aucun visa de travail pour ce poste.
Doit être âgé de 18 ans ou plus.
Vous devez soumettre votre candidature sur la page carrières au www.careers.gevernova.com pour être considéré.

Caractéristiques Souhaitées

Maîtrise en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
Plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'automatisation industrielle dans de grandes organisations.
Expertise en gestion de programmes/projets avec certification officielle (PMP, PRINCE2 ou équivalent) fortement préférée.
Expérience avec l'intégration de systèmes, la sélection de fournisseurs et les équipes de projet interfonctionnelles.
Expérience pratique en mise en service dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de la fabrication ou de l'industrie lourde.
Expérience éprouvée dans l'obtention de résultats au sein d'organisations matricielles et multisites.
Capacité à gérer l'ambiguïté, à mener des projets complexes à terme et à promouvoir les meilleures pratiques.
Apprenant continu avec une passion pour l'excellence opérationnelle et l'innovation.

Essential Responsibilities

Job Description Summary

Le/la chef(fe) de projet, déploiement de l'automatisation, est un(e) expert(e) reconnu(e) en robotique et en automatisation, responsable de la coordination de la construction, de l'intégration et de la mise en service de bout en bout des solutions d'automatisation à l'échelle de l'entreprise GE Vernova. Le/la responsable du déploiement de l'automatisation gère les échéanciers, les budgets et l'alignement des intervenants afin de livrer des projets d'automatisation conformes aux exigences rigoureuses en matière de performance, de sécurité et de cybersécurité. Fort(e) d'une expertise approfondie en automatisation industrielle et en gestion de programmes/projets, ce rôle favorise des déploiements réussis dans des environnements complexes et à grande échelle. The Automation Deployment Leader manages timelines, budgets, and stakeholder alignment to deliver automation projects that meet rigorous performance, safety, and cybersecurity requirements. Coordonner les activités de construction, d'intégration et de mise en service des projets d'automatisation, en assurant le respect des échéanciers et des budgets.
Diriger et exécuter le développement de la portée, des échéanciers, des livrables et des exigences d'intégration du projet, en partenariat avec les intégrateurs de systèmes, les équipes techniques internes et les responsables de la préparation des sites.
Piloter tous les aspects du déploiement de l'automatisation, incluant l'installation, les tests, la validation et la transition vers la production, en assurant la conformité aux normes de sécurité et de cybersécurité.
Gérer les risques, les problèmes et les changements tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, en assurant une communication proactive et une résolution rapide.
Suivre la performance du projet par rapport aux indicateurs clés de performance (ICP), aux jalons et au budget établis, en faisant rapport régulièrement au directeur, Intégration et Mise en service.
Établir et tenir à jour la documentation relative aux plans de projet, aux spécifications techniques, aux listes de contrôle de mise en service et aux leçons apprises.
Collaborer avec les architectes technologiques pour garantir des solutions robustes, évolutives et adaptées aux besoins.
Soutenir la gestion des fournisseurs et la supervision de la performance durant les phases de construction et de mise en service.
Favoriser l'amélioration continue en assurant des revues après-projet et en partageant les meilleures pratiques de déploiement de l'automatisation.
Favoriser l'établissement de solides relations de travail avec les intervenants de l'ingénierie, des opérations, de la sécurité, de la cybersécurité et des fonctions TI/OT.

Qualifications/Exigences

Baccalauréat en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, assorti de plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'automatisation industrielle au sein de grandes organisations OU Diplôme d'études collégiales (ou équivalent) en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, assorti de plus de 10 ans d'expérience pertinente.
Bilingue français/anglais fluide requis. L'employé(e) sera amené(e) à interagir de manière fluide avec des collègues de nos autres installations à travers et/ou à l'extérieur du Canada, et qui sont généralement incapables de communiquer en français et dont la langue de travail est principalement l'anglais.
Expertise dans la gestion réussie de projets d'automatisation vastes et complexes, de la conception jusqu'à la mise en service.
Connaissance experte des architectures d'automatisation, des normes de sécurité et des exigences de cybersécurité en milieu industriel.
Solides compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et de résolution de problèmes.
Excellentes capacités de collaboration, de gestion des fournisseurs et de mobilisation des intervenants.
Compétences supérieures en communication, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral.
Autorisation légale de travailler au Canada requise. Nous ne parrainerons aucun visa de travail pour ce poste.
Doit être âgé de 18 ans ou plus.
Vous devez soumettre votre candidature sur la page carrières au www.careers.gevernova.com pour être considéré.

Caractéristiques Souhaitées

Maîtrise en génie, en automatisation, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
Plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'automatisation industrielle dans de grandes organisations.
Expertise en gestion de programmes/projets avec certification officielle (PMP, PRINCE2 ou équivalent) fortement préférée.
Expérience avec l'intégration de systèmes, la sélection de fournisseurs et les équipes de projet interfonctionnelles.
Expérience pratique en mise en service dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de la fabrication ou de l'industrie lourde.
Expérience éprouvée dans l'obtention de résultats au sein d'organisations matricielles et multisites.
Capacité à gérer l'ambiguïté, à mener des projets complexes à terme et à promouvoir les meilleures pratiques.
Apprenant continu avec une passion pour l'excellence opérationnelle et l'innovation.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead and execute the development of project scope, schedules, deliverables, and integration requirements partnering with system integrators, internal technical teams, and site readiness leads to define
Drives all aspects of automation deployment—including installation, testing, validation, and transition to production—ensuring compliance with safety and cyber standards.

Superior communication skills, both written and verbal.
